      "name": "docs",

      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation and release note updates merely accompany the new index implementation."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements a new optional index under src/index/txoscriptindex.* along with src/index/ordered_varint.h and updates txospenderindex",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds a long-requested output script index allowing historical script and address lookups without wallet imports. Address and script indexing has been attempted across at least five closed PRs dating back to 2013 (#2802, #3652, #6835, #10370, #14053) to allow external wallets and Electrum servers to avoid resource-intensive external indexing software."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds src/rpc/blockchain.cpp getscripthistory RPC implementation and refactors rawtransaction JSON helpers in src/rpc/rawtransaction_util.cpp",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces the getscripthistory RPC method to query transaction history by script hash, address, or ranged descriptor. This resolves a long-standing functional gap where external applications and Electrum servers required separate indexers or wallet imports to query script activity."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/test/fuzz/rpc.cpp and test/functional/test_runner.py",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The functional and unit tests added are specific to verifying txoscriptindex and getscripthistory rather than modifying general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp for index initialization wiring",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Node startup initialization changes follow mechanically from wiring up the new index."
    }
  ],

  }
